name: mobile-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
one_liner: A tool that lets AI assistants directly control and test real phones and phone simulators (tapping buttons, reading screens) instead of a human doing manual QA by hand.
buyer: A mobile app QA lead at a small-to-mid app company who's currently paying for manual testers or a pricier device-farm SaaS.
business_use_cases: A mobile app team wires it into CI so an AI agent runs a full manual-style QA pass on every release build automatically.
A QA outsourcing agency offers 'AI-driven mobile testing' as a cheaper, faster alternative to human manual testers.
An app development shop uses it to auto-generate bug reports with screenshots when a new build breaks a screen.

money_ideas.idea: Managed 'AI QA as a service' subscription for app teams without in-house QA staff.
One-off setup service wiring it into a client's existing CI pipeline and device farm.

steal_this: Wire it into a real app's CI pipeline this weekend, record a before/after of catching a UI bug automatically, and pitch 'AI QA' as a service to indie app developers.
